title: Ex-boss of Pride in London given suspended sentence for ‘harvesting’ documents
summary_full: Christopher Joell-Deshields accessed internal records after organisation sacked him in ‘flagrant flouting’ of court orderThe sacked boss of the Pride in London LGBTQ+ parade has been given a suspended prison sentence for his “flagrant” contempt of court when accessing the organisation’s records in breach of a judicial order.Christopher Joell-Deshields, who was suspended as chief executive in summer 2025 and sacked in April, failed to give up access to Pride’s IT systems as ordered by the high court and instead “harvested” documents for his own use.
